Frequently asked questions

Are PakToolkit tools really free?

Yes. Every tool on PakToolkit is free to use, with no sign-up and no account. Open a tool and use it — that is all.

Are my files uploaded to your server?

No. Every tool runs inside your browser on your own device. Your images, PDFs and numbers never leave your device, and we cannot see them.

Why does PakToolkit focus on Pakistan?

Global tool sites do not offer a bijli bill calculator with Pakistani tariff slabs, MDCAT aggregate, salary tax 2025-26 or a Marla/Kanal converter. PakToolkit starts with the tools Pakistan actually searches for, plus universal image and PDF tools.

Do the calculators give final official figures?

They give accurate estimates from published rates. For money matters, the official figure — your DISCO bill, FBR assessment or the notified nisab — is always final. Each calculator page explains its basis.
